verdict.rationale: The axis applies: TeamViewer is a SaaS product with a public Web API, so it could plausibly publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs. The probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at webapi.teamviewer.com/llms.txt) and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. The existing human-oriented Web API docs are only adjacent and do not count as agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
